code='''def transform(grid):
    # Four aligned 4x4 masks are separated by columns of 3s.
    blocks = [[ [grid[r][start + c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
              for start in (0, 5, 10, 15)]
    # On overlap, the fixed front-to-back order is 9, 4, 8, 5.
    priority = (9, 4, 8, 5)
    return [[next((color for color, block in zip(priority, (blocks[2], blocks[3], blocks[0], blocks[1]))
                  if block[r][c] == color), 0)
             for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
'''
